body: r32 last round (2026-10-07): with the oauthproxy skip header (X-Skip-OAuth-Proxy), a preview deployment now accepts an unsealed authorization code and exchanges it with its own callback (before: only codes production relayed sealed). The provider's PKCE check still protects the exchange. New generic hook oauth.RequestAuthURLer. SCIM Entra row stays partial: Microsoft's validator not run, its request shapes replayed in a test.
